name: Chikan Densha CUM EGG
source:
This game has been machine translated from Bulgarian-style English into Japanese by an android from the distant future. The aim of the game is to create a human being and collect 15 friends. It is not suitable for children.

[translated from [url=https://liamkneesocks.itch.io/cumegg]itch.io[/url]]

THIS GAME IS ONLY IN JAPANESE, original English version lost on USB thumbstick at starbuck California please find USB and post to home of Kneesocks. If you do not can't read language of Japanese it is ok I do not know language either it is good game even without word.

[from [url=https://liamkneesocks.itch.io/cumegg]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一款由来自遥远未来的仿生人，将类似保加利亚式英语的文本机器翻译成日语后制作的游戏。游戏的目标是创造一个人类，并收集15名朋友。不适合儿童。

[译自[url=https://liamkneesocks.itch.io/cumegg]itch.io[/url]]

本作只有日文版，原版英文文本据说遗失在加州某家星巴克的USB存储棒上。请找到那根USB，并寄到Kneesocks的主页。如果你看不懂日语也没关系，因为我同样不懂这门语言；即使没有文字，这依然是一款好游戏。

[来自[url=https://liamkneesocks.itch.io/cumegg]itch.io[/url]]
